photos.alt: Wide late-July back garden with Rising Sun redbud, grapevine lattice, Limelight Prime hydrangea, ornamental onions, and raised beds
photos.caption: Late July has the back garden layered from top to bottom: Rising Sun redbud lights the left, the grapevine thickens the middle, and Limelight Prime holds lime-white bloom above the onion and milkweed layer.

photos.alt: Dwarf peach tree with a full dense canopy of clean green leaves in its brick-edged raised bed
photos.caption: The dwarf peach has built a dense, clean midsummer canopy, all long healthy leaves and a compact umbrella shape over its brick-edged pocket.

photos.alt: Dwarf peach canopy above purple Pugster butterfly bush in a brick-edged raised garden bed
photos.caption: The peach and Pugster are holding their summer layers beautifully: a compact green canopy overhead, purple bloom in front, and the raised beds still legible through the July density.

photos.alt: Limelight Prime hydrangea with lime-white panicles blooming behind pale-pink ornamental onions and orange milkweed
photos.caption: Limelight Prime is deep into its lime-white July flush, rising behind a soft pink field of ornamental onions while orange milkweed keeps the front edge glowing.

photos.alt: Dwarf crape myrtle covered in dense vivid red flower clusters above glossy green foliage
photos.caption: The dwarf crape myrtle is holding a dense second week of red bloom, with fresh yellow-centered flowers, fading clusters, and unopened buds all packed across the compact shrub.

photos.alt: Healthy jalapeno pepper plant carrying several large dark green peppers and new flower buds
photos.caption: The jalapeño has reached a heavy harvest stage, carrying several full-sized dark-green peppers at once while new flowers and smaller fruit continue above them.

photos.alt: Dense clusters of green grapes hanging beneath grape leaves on a wooden arbor
photos.caption: The grape arbor is carrying an exceptional midsummer crop, with tightly packed green clusters now filling the spaces between the leaves and wooden rails.

photos.alt: Bobo hydrangea covered in white panicles above burgundy heuchera in the front raised box
photos.caption: Bobo has reached its bright white July phase in the front raised box, with panicles packed from the railing down to the burgundy heuchera at the timber edge.

photos.alt: Cluster of deep red daylilies with gold throats, unopened buds, and spent flowers
photos.caption: The red daylily is still cycling hard: fresh gold-throated flowers, unopened buds, and spent blooms all share the same vigorous clump.

photos.alt: Limelight Prime hydrangea blooming behind pink ornamental onions with Gold Dust aucuba and cucumber vine at the sides
photos.caption: Limelight Prime now carries lime panicles above a front edge of pale pink ornamental onions, framed by Gold Dust aucuba on the left and a climbing cucumber vine on the right.

photos.alt: Close view of a lime-green Limelight Prime hydrangea panicle with small florets opening
photos.caption: A close look at Limelight Prime's early bloom texture, with tiny fertile flowers and larger pale florets opening through the lime-green panicle.

photos.alt: Wide midsummer back garden with Rising Sun redbud, Bobo hydrangea, hostas, Pugster butterfly bush, tomatoes, and peppers
photos.caption: The back garden at midsummer density: Rising Sun redbud glows above the shaded left bed, Bobo hydrangea and hostas fill the brick edge, and purple Pugster bloom leads into tall tomatoes and fruiting peppers across the raised beds.

photos.alt: Dwarf crape myrtle covered in vivid red flowers and unopened buds beside a pepper plant
photos.caption: The dwarf crape myrtle has made the jump from late-June buds to a full red July display, with dozens of flower clusters open and another round still waiting at the tips.

photos.alt: Recovered variegated Japanese euonymus with variegated hostas and heuchera against a brick foundation
photos.caption: The bright focal shrub here is the recovered variegated Japanese euonymus, not Sunshine ligustrum. It has filled into a lively golden-and-green canopy above flowering heuchera and cream-edged hostas.

photos.alt: Bobo hydrangea with many lime-white panicle blooms beside a brick wall
photos.caption: Bobo hydrangea in a heavy July display: lime-white panicles are open all over the compact shrub, with more flower heads still coming along.

photos.alt: Close-up of a deep red daylily with a bright gold throat
photos.caption: A deep red daylily at its July peak, with darker veining through the petals and a bright gold throat.

photos.alt: Red daylily flowers with a dense queue of unopened buds
photos.caption: The red daylily has a long next act queued: open flowers sit among many unopened buds along the vigorous green clump.

photos.alt: Side-house foundation bed with Sunshine ligustrum, Shaina Japanese maple, purple loropetalum, variegated liriope, and rhododendron
photos.caption: The side-house foundation bed in early July: Sunshine ligustrum lights the center in chartreuse, Shaina maple carries the right side, and purple loropetalum with variegated liriope keeps a dark, striped foreground below the mature rhododendron canopy.

photos.alt: Pugster butterfly bush in heavy purple bloom below grapevine leaves and green grape clusters on a white lattice
photos.caption: July arrives dense and blooming: Pugster butterfly bush is covered in purple cones, grape clusters are visible through the lattice behind it, and the Gold Dust aucuba holds the right side glossy and bright.

photos.alt: Side-house foundation bed with mature rhododendron, Sunshine ligustrum, hostas, heuchera, groundcover, and mown lawn corridor
photos.caption: Wide June side-house bed view: mature rhododendron anchoring the foundation planting, Sunshine ligustrum glowing at the front corner, hostas and heuchera filling the lower layer, and the lawn corridor cut clean beside it.

photos.alt: Many green grape clusters hanging from a grapevine trained over a wooden arbor
photos.caption: The grapevine is loaded with green clusters now, hanging along the arbor rail and arch under broad clean leaves.

photos.alt: Grapevine heavily leafed out around a wooden arbor and garden gate with grape clusters visible
photos.caption: The garden gate has become a grapevine threshold, with dense leaves and visible green clusters on the right and Rising Sun redbud color glowing over the left side.

photos.alt: Pink and white yarrow flowers blooming above fine ferny foliage
photos.caption: Yarrow in a soft late-June bloom: pink and cream flat-topped clusters are open together above fine ferny foliage, making a broad pastel pollinator layer.

photos.alt: Dwarf crape myrtle foliage with red stems and many flower buds set
photos.caption: The dwarf crape myrtle is in its pre-bloom stage now: clean glossy leaves, red stems, and rounded buds set across the branch tips.

photos.alt: Ornamental onion foliage with pale curved flower scapes and unopened buds
photos.caption: Ornamental onion just before opening, with pale curved scapes, swollen buds, dense blue-green foliage, and the first hint of purple showing on one lower bud.

photos.alt: Several dark green cucumbers hanging from a healthy vine with yellow blossoms
photos.caption: The cucumber vine is fully into harvest mode now: several clean dark-green cucumbers are sizing up at once, with yellow flowers still open and more fruit coming behind them.

photos.alt: Wide back garden view with Rising Sun redbud, grapevine on lattice, orange milkweed, and dense summer planting
photos.caption: Wide late-June back garden view: Rising Sun redbud glowing on the left, grapevine thick across the lattice, orange milkweed and purple spikes in the foreground, and the whole path-side bed at summer density.

photos.alt: Side-house foundation bed with Sunshine ligustrum, purple loropetalum, variegated liriope, and Shaina Japanese maple
photos.caption: The side-house foundation bed is reading as a summer color block now: Sunshine ligustrum glowing chartreuse, purple loropetalum through the front, variegated liriope edging the bed, and Shaina maple holding the right side.

photos.alt: Rising Sun redbud canopy above a dense summer bed with orange milkweed in bloom
photos.caption: Rising Sun redbud is still glowing above the back bed, with orange milkweed in full bloom below and the shaded path pulling through the middle.

photos.alt: Large dark green cucumber fruit hanging from the vine with yellow blossoms around it
photos.caption: Cucumber fruit set is confirmed: a large clean fruit is already hanging on the vine, with more yellow blossoms and small developing cucumbers tucked around it.

photos.alt: Healthy cucumber vine climbing a support in the raised vegetable bed
photos.caption: The cucumber vine has filled the raised-bed corner fast, climbing the support with broad clean leaves, tendrils, and yellow flowers.

photos.alt: Pugster butterfly bush flower spike in full purple bloom
photos.caption: Pugster butterfly bush in full purple bloom, with dense flower cones open and fresh buds still stacked toward the tips.

photos.alt: Pugster butterfly bush blooming purple below a leafy dwarf peach and near orange milkweed
photos.caption: The raised bed in mid-June layers: purple Pugster bloom in front, dwarf peach foliage above, orange milkweed behind, and the path edge holding everything together.

photos.alt: Variegated hostas filling the shaded border in June
photos.caption: The hosta border is fully lush in early June, with clean ribbed leaves, green centers, cream margins, and enough chartreuse variation to keep the shade bed bright.

photos.alt: Cucumber vine climbing a green trellis in the vegetable bed
photos.caption: Cucumber vine settling into the vegetable bed, with broad healthy leaves, fresh top growth, and tendrils already reaching for the green cage support.

photos.alt: Hostas growing under Gold Dust aucuba in the shaded border
photos.caption: Hostas under the Gold Dust aucuba, where the speckled evergreen canopy and broad variegated leaves make a layered green-and-gold shade composition.

photos.alt: Wide shaded border with hostas beneath Gold Dust aucuba
photos.caption: The wide shade-border view: hostas tucked along the brick edge beneath Gold Dust aucuba, with different leaf sizes and variegation patterns carrying the whole low layer.

photos.alt: Small blue butterfly close-up feeding on purple catmint flowers
photos.caption: A small blue/azure-type butterfly feeding on purple catmint, with the pale blue-white wing underside, fine dark markings, and striped antennae sharp in the macro crop.

photos.alt: Close side view of a small blue butterfly on catmint buds
photos.caption: Another tight angle on the small blue butterfly, showing the fuzzy wing edge, dark dash markings, and the tiny scale of the visitor against the catmint flowers.

photos.alt: Small blue butterfly on purple catmint flowers above brown mulch
photos.caption: The wider context frame: a small blue butterfly tucked onto a purple catmint flower spike above the mulch, easy to miss until the wings catch the light.

photos.alt: Lemony Lace elderberry in bright chartreuse summer foliage on the brick patio
photos.caption: Lemony Lace elderberry showing its early-summer form: airy upright branching, clean cutleaf chartreuse foliage, and bright new growth at the tips against the back garden beds.

photos.alt: Garden arbor and gate enclosed by grapevine and Rising Sun redbud foliage
photos.caption: The garden entry has turned into a green threshold: grapevine leaves and young clusters filling the arbor, Rising Sun redbud glowing on the left, and the path still pulling through the shade.

photos.alt: View through the grapevine-covered arbor into the June garden
photos.caption: Looking through the arbor into the June garden, with grape leaves overhead, redbud foliage along the right, hostas and daylily foliage at the path edge, and the raised beds opening beyond.

photos.alt: Close grapevine clusters with small green grapes under broad leaves
photos.caption: Grapevine fruit set is strong: tight green clusters are already sizing up under broad, clean leaves on the arbor.

photos.alt: Back garden raised beds in full early summer growth
photos.caption: The raised beds have moved into full early-summer density, with orange milkweed in bloom, purple speedwell and salvia tones still showing, tomatoes climbing the fence, and the potted Lemony Lace elderberry anchoring the patio edge.

photos.alt: Rising Sun redbud glowing yellow green above the June garden
photos.caption: Rising Sun redbud still acting like the garden's overhead light in early June, with the bright canopy over hostas, purple blooms, daylily foliage, and the layered path-side planting below.

photos.alt: Orange milkweed blooming heavily in the raised mixed bed
photos.caption: Orange milkweed has hit full early-summer bloom, throwing hot orange clusters across the raised bed while the surrounding foliage fills in thick behind it.

photos.alt: Large carpenter bee on orange milkweed flowers
photos.caption: A large carpenter bee-type visitor working the orange milkweed, dusted with pollen and pressed deep into the bright flowers.

photos.alt: Front raised planter with Pugster butterfly bush and Orange Rocket barberry
photos.caption: Front raised planter in late-May sun: Pugster butterfly bush is dense and budded in front, while Orange Rocket barberry throws a strong red vertical backdrop by the steps.

photos.alt: Side-house foundation bed with Sunshine ligustrum and Shaina maple
photos.caption: Side-house foundation bed settling into color blocks: Sunshine ligustrum bright on the left, Shaina Japanese maple red on the right, and burgundy low shrubs, heuchera, and liriope beginning to stitch the front edge together.

photos.alt: Purple speedwell blooming below Gold Dust aucuba with a small pollinator
photos.caption: Purple speedwell still throwing fresh flower spikes below the Gold Dust aucuba, with a small pollinator visible among the blooms.

photos.alt: Side-house foundation bed under the rhododendron in late May
photos.caption: The side-house foundation bed reading as a full layered planting: rhododendron canopy overhead, Shaina maple and Sunshine ligustrum glowing behind, hostas, heuchera, sweetspire, and low front growth filling the edge.

photos.alt: Little Henry sweetspire blooming with white flower racemes
photos.caption: Little Henry sweetspire has moved from bud stage into bloom, with white racemes arching out over clean green foliage after rain.

photos.alt: Sunshine ligustrum with variegated liriope in the side-house bed
photos.caption: Sunshine ligustrum at peak chartreuse against the brick, with variegated liriope repeating along the front edge and dark loropetalum tucked below.

photos.alt: Lush grapevine arbor and garden gate in late May
photos.caption: The garden gate fully framed by late-May growth: Rising Sun redbud glowing on the left, grapevine leaves and young clusters filling the arbor and lattice, and the path still holding a clear line through the dense planting.

photos.alt: Front raised bed with Bobo hydrangea, heuchera, and salvia
photos.caption: The front raised box filling in with Bobo hydrangea, burgundy heuchera, and purple salvia holding the edge by the railing.

photos.alt: Raised mixed perennial bed with Pugster and milkweed
photos.caption: The raised mixed perennial bed moving into late-May fullness: Pugster foliage, milkweed buds, speedwell in the back, and sedum at the front edge.

photos.alt: Purple speedwell flower spikes in bloom
photos.caption: Purple speedwell in a strong late-May bloom flush, with violet spikes still carrying fresh buds at the tips after rain.

photos.alt: Purple speedwell blooming below Gold Dust aucuba
photos.caption: The shaded aucuba corner with speedwell blooming in front, hostas tucked behind, and the raised-bed edge keeping the dense planting tidy.

photos.alt: Hoverfly visiting purple salvia flowers
photos.caption: Hoverfly working the purple salvia in full sun, wings shining and yellow markings clear against the magenta blooms.

photos.alt: Lush late-May garden overview with redbud and grapevine
photos.caption: The back garden in full late-May leaf, with Rising Sun redbud glowing, grapevine softening the lattice, and the lower perennial layers filling in around the path.

photos.alt: Raised beds with vegetables, white rose, and coreopsis
photos.caption: Raised beds settling in after rain, white rose blooming along the fence, coreopsis lighting the front edge, and the vines starting to claim the backdrop.

photos.alt: Rising Sun redbud in bloom with golden new leaves
photos.caption: Rising Sun redbud hitting that electric overlap of hot pink bloom and golden new foliage. One of those brief spring windows where it looks lit from inside.

photos.alt: Climbing hydrangea training up a trellis fence
photos.caption: Climbing hydrangea in a clean spring push, bright foliage, good upward reach, and just starting to claim its support with real confidence.
